title: First relay setup on a new machine fails on the paid hold
what: relay setup on a machine with no paid-run record writes its files and its sync does not exit 1 with the list of every relay commit: like relay install, setup's sync does not wait for a green paid run, or says in one line what is held and why.
why: 25 Oct, a throwaway project in a fake HOME (scratchpad reports/demo-and-release.md, part 1): relay setup shop exited 1, "Not synced: waits for a green paid run ... no green run recorded" and 50 of 174 commits; CLAUDE.local.md was not written. Every new machine hits it. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: relay setup <tmp project> with HOME set to an empty temporary folder: exit 1 and the hold message; no CLAUDE.local.md.
pass_cases: Same run: exit 0 and CLAUDE.local.md written (or exit 0 with a one-line note of what waits); the hold still applies to relay sync on a machine that has a paid-run record.

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `why` line 1 points to a session file (`reports/demo-and-release.md`, part 1, 25 Oct, in the session session folder; a copy is in relay's backup folder), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.

Measured 25 Oct in a throwaway project with a fake HOME: `relay setup shop` with no flags wrote its files but exited 1, because its built-in `relay sync` refused: "Not synced: waits for a green paid run; merged since the last one: no green run recorded", followed by a list of 50 of relay's 174 commits (the hold is at lib/relay_rules.py line 284: sync writes no files outside the checkout until relay's current commit has a green paid run). The record of paid runs is in the machine's ~/.relay, which a fake HOME, like a new user, does not have. With `RELAY_SKIP_PAID_DUE=1` (the code's own path for tests that sync into temporary targets, lib/relay_rules.py lines 282-283) sync wrote CLAUDE.local.md and the other files. The documented path for a new machine, `relay install`, calls sync with wait=False, but `relay setup` after it hits the hold again.
